name: Brontle · Gremlet #39
description:
A long-necked dinosaur who can see over every window. Very gentle, always chewing.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Brontle in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
